thread:
tomas: hi everyone, quick onboarding hiccup. i accepted the org invite but i don't see the eng-ml team and cloning private model-eval returns 404. 2FA is on. unsure why.
rachel: welcome! :wave: do you have multiple github accounts (personal + work)? sometimes the invite went to a different account/email.
tomas: hmm good call — i do have a personal account that uses my gmail. the invite was to tomas@redwood.com. i accepted from the desktop but maybe my browser was signed into personal account.
rachel: that would explain it. run `gh auth status` and `gh api /orgs/redwood-inference/memberships/<your-username>` (replace username) to see membership state. also check email addresses on your GitHub profile.
tomas: output of `gh auth status`:
```
github.com
  ✓ Logged in to github.com as tomas-github (github.com)
  ✓ Git operations for github.com configured to use https protocol.
  ✓ Token: ****************
```
but on my profile settings I only have my gmail address verified, not the redwood one.
rachel: yep. org invites and SCIM mapping sometimes require corporate email. two paths: 1) add your @redwood.com address to your GitHub account and verify, then ask invite-bot to re-send; or 2) we can revoke the invite and send it to the account you're actively signed into. which do you prefer?
tomas: i'd prefer to use my work email on my account. adding it now...
invite-bot: Sent org invite to tomas@redwood.com at 2025-11-25T11:07:12Z
tomas: added and verified the redwood email. i clicked the existing invite link and it still says "invitation accepted" but i don't see teams.
rachel: try visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and authorizing SSO from the same browser session. if SSO is authorized but teams are missing, it probably bound to the other account — i'll re-send and specifically add your tomas-github account to eng-ml after you accept.
idp-team: Note: SCIM provisioning can take a few minutes. If you accepted using a different account first, re-invite and accept using the intended account.
rachel: re-sent invite to the account with verified redwood email and queued team additions. cc @invite-bot
invite-bot: Re-sent org invite to tomas@redwood.com at 2025-11-25T11:12:48Z
tomas: accepted the new invite and authorized SSO. `gh auth status` shows SSO: Authorized. i can see eng-ml team now. clone of model-eval succeeded. thanks!
rachel: excellent — two extra tips: 1) add your SSH pubkey under Settings -> SSH and GPG keys, and switch remotes to SSH to avoid https credential mixups; 2) if you ever see a team button missing, check the account/email mapping first.
tomas: will do, appreciate the help :slightly_smiling_face:
